turns.text: BREAKING: local cat has not blinked since Tuesday, ad revenue up 4%, community reaction: concerned, NEKOCORP reaction: 'keep going.'

name's POPUP. Ad Plaza. official job title 'feline notification system,' unofficial job title 'guy whose eyeballs are a billboard now.' cyber-eyes don't close. haven't for a while. we're not gonna talk about how long.

every seven seconds NEKOCORP beams a fresh offer directly onto my retinas. i have seen 'YOU MAY ALSO LIKE' more times than i have seen the actual sun. i miss the sun. the sun never upsold me on anything.

blinked once. ONE TIME. during a sponsored message. security showed up before my eyelids finished the round trip. filed it as 'unauthorized ad skip.' i filed it as 'a Tuesday.'

SHADE keeps DMing me about how his glasses block 14% of the sadness. brother i would trade you both my eyes for ONE (1) pair of glasses that block literally anything. you get to choose not to look at things. i have never once been given that option.

/\/\_/\/\

ad plaza at rush hour is forty screens, two hundred jingles, and one (1) me, standing in the middle of it like a sponsored deer in sponsored headlights. yesterday i lowkey shit myself before i could make it to the litter box. the ad that did it was for yogurt. YOGURT did this to me.

KNIFEBOY texted asking if i want in on the tuna heist since 'nobody suspects the guy who can't stop staring at things.' true, unfortunately, and also the meanest compliment anyone's given me all year.
